# openai_user_role (Resource)

Manage an organization-level role assignment for a user.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_user_role" "example" {
  user_id = "user_123"
  role_id = "role_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) role id
- `user_id` (String) user id

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_user_role.example
  id = "user_123/role_123"
}
```
